messages:
alana: Quick PR incoming to tighten the docs for transient 429s/timeouts and recommended fallback patterns. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1401
pete: please 1) define 'grace window' as opt-in routing behavior, 2) add a tiny ops checklist, 3) include minimal py/js snippets. keep everything short.
shiv: Ops requests a 3-step repro/checklist: synthetic repro cmd, KV cache hit-rate check, and model-selection log grep. Also note streaming limitations when switching models mid-request.
ci-bot: PR #1401 created by alana. lint OK, link-check pending. preview deploy queued.
alana: snippets will be inline (2 short blocks) and larger examples linked at bottom. Example PY snippet:```python
try:
  r = client.generate(model="goliath-1", input=text)
except TooManyRequestsError:
  time.sleep(0.6)
  r = client.generate(model="nimble-1", input=text)
```
JS example:```js
try {
  const r = await client.generate({model: 'goliath-1', input})
} catch (e) {
  await sleep(600)
  const r2 = await client.generate({model: 'nimble-1', input})
}
```
pete: add "Known limitations": streaming may not be preserved; cache warmness not carried across models; fallback is opt-in. Also include small FAQ: "Should I enable fallback?" Answer: "Opt-in; useful when latency SLOs trump peak model quality; test with your prompts."
billing-bot: Billing confirms: tokens are billed for each executed request at the model actually run. If a retry/fallback issues multiple requests, billing reflects those executions. Recommend calling this out.
alana: adding a labeled synthetic repro command for support:```bash
hey load -c 160 -n 350 "curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"model\":\"goliath-1\",\"input\":\"probe\"}'"
```
shiv: LGTM. I'll add the ops checklist and a 3-line troubleshooting table mapping symptoms to actions.
ci-bot: preview built at 2026-03-23T22:05:00Z. link-check passed.
alana: merging after a quick doc owner review. thanks all :thumbsup:
